title: docs(changeset): date-note nine pending entries whose repository count moved (objectui#10979)
body:
Fixes #10979
Clause-②: no — release-note prose only; no accept set or public surface changes.

## What this does

Eleven pending changesets were named on the card as stating a present-tense repository count that is false on `main`. Each count was re-derived here on `main` at `2eaf5be27` (the commit the PM read at dispatch), with the query printed below and, as its positive control, the same query at the entry's own landing commit or base.

- **Nine entries re-derive false on `main`.** Each gets one dated note (2026-09-29), placed directly after the paragraph that holds the counted sentence. That is the objectui#10877 / PR objectui#10891 form. The note quotes the sentence, gives the reading at the entry's own landing commit (or base), names what moved it and in which PR, and gives the re-measured reading at `2eaf5be27` in the past tense. Two of the nine (`5134`, `7497`) do not re-derive even at their own base, and their notes say so instead of claiming the sentence was ever true.
- **Two entries are left untouched** (`9187`, `3965`). Their sentences re-derive true on `main`; the reasons are in the table.
- Frontmatter is byte-identical in all eleven files, and no existing line is edited or deleted: `git diff --numstat 2eaf5be27 HEAD` is 98 insertions, 0 deletions, over 9 files.
- **No new changeset.** The diff is `.changeset/` only, and `check-changeset-presence` says none is owed (output below).

## The ruling this write relies on

On 2026-09-29, in the `domain:spec @ objectui` seat's chat, the maintainer chose 「Allow the appended note (Recommended)」. Recorded on this card as comment `5883370240` (the same text is `5883360525` on objectui#4356):

> You allow developers to append dated correction notes to pending .changeset files (appended only, no existing line or frontmatter edited). ... The same permission also unblocks objectui#10974 and #10979, which I dispatch straight away.

## Per entry

Readings are over tracked files at a named commit. "Base" means the parent of the squash commit, the commit the change landed on.

| Entry | Counted sentence (quoted) | Reading at landing | Reading on `main` `2eaf5be27` | Query | Outcome |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|

| `component-meta-converge-and-deprecate-alias-5893` | "In-repo, `PluginComponentMeta` has exactly one occurrence — its own export line" | 1 line in 1 file at the base `575b71c850`; 13 lines in 5 files at the landing commit `6d1c15536` itself | 19 lines in 7 files; 1 importing `.ts` file, this change's own pin | Q2 | **Noted.** True at its base. Its own pins and prose moved it, then objectui#5674 (PR #10826) added more. |
| `6296-conditionbuilder-subject-vocabulary` | "all five files that mount it today — six mount sites" | 6 sites in 5 files at `88b15fddc` | 7 sites in 6 files | Q3 | **Noted.** objectui#6226 (PR #6668) mounted it in `FlowNodeConfigField`, a flattened-scope site. |

The parenthetical was already non-exhaustive at landing (`ai-zero-read-members-retired-8178.test.ts` and `SchemaForm.gridCellNaming.test.tsx` carried the literal and are not named), so nothing went false after landing. |

No tracked-file reading gives 4,362. | 6,700 tracked files, 5,819 TS/JS sources | Q6 | **Noted.** False on `main` by any tracked-file reading. The note does not claim the figure held at its base. The 13 / 32 split is not re-classified, and the note says so. |

The note names the base commit and scopes out the rest. |

## Queries, as printed

Each line below was re-run in exactly this form. REV is the commit named in the table. A match on a tag-shaped name is spelled `\x3c`, because the body sanitizer eats a literal opening angle bracket.

```bash
# Q1
git grep -lE '"operator"\s*:\s*"(gt|lt|eq)"' REV -- examples/schema-catalog | wc -l
git grep -lE '"operator"\s*:\s*"(equals|less_than|greater_than)"' 2eaf5be27 -- examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/components-complex-filter-builder | wc -l
# Q2
git grep -h -c PluginComponentMeta REV | paste -sd+ | bc; git grep -l PluginComponentMeta REV | wc -l
git grep -lE 'import[^;]*PluginComponentMeta' 2eaf5be27 -- '*.ts' '*.tsx' | wc -l
# Q3
git grep -nP '\x3cConditionBuilder\b' REV -- ':!*.test.*' ':!**/__tests__/**' ':!*.md'
# Q4
git grep -nE 'reportUnresolvableVisibilityPredicate\(' REV -- ':!*.test.*' ':!**/__tests__/**' ':!*.md' ':!packages/react/src/utils/visibilityDiagnostic.ts'
# Q5
git grep -lE 'import \{[^}]*\bresolveI18nLabel\b' REV -- ':!*.test.*' ':!**/__tests__/**' ':!*.md' ':!*.mdx' ':!packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx' | wc -l
git grep -nE '\bresolveInlineI18nLabel\(' REV -- ':!*.test.*' ':!**/__tests__/**' ':!*.md' ':!*.mdx' ':!packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx' | grep -vE '^[^:]+:[^:]+:[0-9]+:\s*(\*|//)' | wc -l
# Q6
git ls-tree -r --name-only REV -- packages apps examples e2e scripts | wc -l
git ls-tree -r --name-only REV -- packages apps examples e2e scripts | grep -cE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|cjs|mts|cts)$'
# Q7
git grep -nE '\bnormalizeSchemaReferenceKeys\(' REV -- ':!*.test.*' ':!**/__tests__/**' ':!*.md'
# Q8
git grep -nP '\x3cInspectorSelectField\b' REV -- ':!*.test.*' ':!**/__tests__/**' ':!*.md'
# Q9
git ls-tree -r --name-only REV -- examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas | grep -cE '\.json$'
git grep -hoE '"type"\s*:\s*"button"' REV -- ':(glob)examples/**/*.json' ':(glob)apps/console/**/*.json' ':(glob)content/docs/**/*.json' ':(glob)packages/**/*.json' | wc -l
git grep -hoE '"type"\s*:\s*"action:(button|icon)"' REV -- ':(glob)examples/**/*.json' ':(glob)apps/console/**/*.json' ':(glob)content/docs/**/*.json' ':(glob)packages/**/*.json' | wc -l
# Q10
git grep -lE "layout['\"]?\s*:\s*['\"]grid['\"]" REV -- ':!**/CHANGELOG.md'
# Q11
git grep -h -cE '"type"\s*:\s*"div"' REV -- examples/schema-catalog | paste -sd+ | bc
```

At its landing commit or base, each query reproduces the sentence it tests (the "Reading at landing" column). That is the positive control. The exceptions are `5134` and `7497`, where no reading reproduces the figure, and the table says so. The checkout is shallow (boundary 2026-07-20). Every commit named above is inside that window: the landing commits date from 2026-08-21 to 2026-09-12, and each supersession ordering was read with `git merge-base --is-ancestor`, which returned exit 0.

- The adjacent suites that walk `.changeset/` (`body-dialect-census`, `dollar-dialect-alias-census`, `check-installed-spec-pin-claims`, `check-control-bytes`, `quick-reference-current-release-4143`, `render-changeset-claims-comment`): Test Files 6 passed (6), Tests 164 passed (164). No test names any of the nine files.

## Acceptance notes

These are observations only. None is filed.

- `6837-reference-to-arm-deletion` carries other present-tense counts that the card does not name ("Eleven of the sixteen sites", "Three readers"). They are not measured here.
- `8450`: the "13 of the 45" / "The other 32" classification is not re-derived. The note says it stays the reading of that change.
- `3965`: "the catalog ratchet closes to zero tolerance for JSON-authored `div`" reads as absolute, while the `components-basic-div` exemption (2 fixture files, 5 nodes) stands. This is unchanged since landing.
- `5134`: at its base, a search for the unaliased `resolveI18nLabel(` returned four lines, all doc comments. This is recorded as an observation, not as the source of the figure.
